subject.title: feat(mxc): add Windows MXC sandbox backend

question: Should OpenClaw accept @microsoft/mxc-sdk 0.7.0’s native dependency graph and full configuration envelope carried through process arguments for this preview external sandbox plugin?
rationale: The implementation can mitigate surrounding behavior but cannot change the upstream SDK transport or decide whether that exposure and native supply-chain boundary are acceptable for an official OpenClaw plugin.

options.title: Approve preview boundary
options.body: Replay onto current main, renew Windows proof, and authorize the exact dependency graph and argv transport for the reviewed head.

options.title: Wait for upstream transport
options.body: Pause this PR until MXC provides a non-argv configuration transport, then reassess the dependency graph and plugin package.

recommendation.title: Approve preview boundary
recommendation.body: Replay onto current main, renew Windows proof, and authorize the exact dependency graph and argv transport for the reviewed head.
